responsibility: Defines rustc’s target-specific inline-assembly description layer. Its shared `mod.rs` provides the architecture-independent framework—register-definition macros, common enums and modifier metadata, parsing/validation plumbing, per-architecture integration, and clobber-ABI coordination—while the per-target files (`aarch64`, `arm`, `avr`, `bpf`, `hexagon`, `mips`, `msp430`, `nvptx`, `powerpc`, `riscv`, `s390x`, `spirv`, `wasm`, and `x86`) each specify that architecture’s inline `asm!` register classes, concrete registers or registerless operand models, aliases and overlap relationships, supported operand types, emitted register syntax/modifiers, and target-specific availability or reserved-register validation.
